app.name: Mannon
app.tagline: Wholesale quoting, without the email grind

install.body: Mannon runs your wholesale prices, registration forms, order limits and net terms inside Shopify — and gives your buyers an agent that answers “what's my price at 100 units?” without a support ticket.
install.hint: Enter the .myshopify.com domain, not your custom domain.

home.description: Your wholesale command center — KPIs, the Merchant Agent briefing, and what needs you today.

pricing.description: Every price rule in one place: volume tiers, custom prices, discounts, priority and combinations.

customers.description: Approve wholesale applications, manage groups and tiers, and keep tags in sync.

forms.description: Build and publish the registration form buyers fill in to apply for wholesale.

orders.description: Wholesale orders, order limits, net payment terms, quotes and draft orders.

storefrontAgent.description: Configure the Buyer Agent your wholesale customers chat with, and review every conversation.

analytics.description: Wholesale revenue, rule performance, the registration funnel and net-terms aging.

settings.description: Price display, discount combinations, notifications, translations, agent controls and the audit log.

plans.description: Your plan, what it includes, and an honest recommendation based on how you actually use Mannon.

pastDue.body_other: Your {{plan}} features keep working for {{count}} more days. Update the payment method in Shopify to avoid any interruption.

test.heading: Test subscription
test.body: This subscription is in Shopify's test mode, so no money changes hands.

error.heading: We couldn't start that change
error.body: Shopify didn't accept the request. Nothing was charged — try again, and if it keeps happening, contact us.

advisorSoon.heading: Plan advice is coming
advisorSoon.body: Once Mannon has a month of your usage, Claude will tell you whether your plan still fits — including when the honest answer is to stay where you are.

planTagline.free: One pricing rule and one form — enough to see Mannon work on a real product.
planTagline.growth: Unlimited rules and forms, CSV import, auto-tagging and order limits.
planTagline.pro: Net terms, shipping rules, draft orders, POS, Markets — and the Merchant Agent.
planTagline.agentic: The storefront Buyer Agent, PO-to-order, quote drafting and ERP sync.

csv.withErrors_other: {{count}} rows have problems and will be skipped

csv.undoneBody_one: The {{count}} rule this import created has been removed. Nothing else changed.
csv.undoneBody_other: The {{count}} rules this import created have been removed. Nothing else changed.

issue.missing_required: This is required and was empty.

issue.ragged_row: This row has a different number of columns from the header.
issue.duplicate_row: This row repeats an earlier one.

list.heading: Wholesale buyers
list.emptyBody: A customer counts as wholesale once they join a group or carry the “{{tag}}” tag. Share a registration form to start collecting applications.
list.syncingBody_one: {{count}} customer imported so far. The list fills in as it goes.
list.syncingBody_other: {{count}} customers imported so far. The list fills in as it goes.
list.syncingFirstBody_one: {{count}} customer so far. This runs in the background and takes a few minutes on a large store.
list.syncingFirstBody_other: {{count}} customers so far. This runs in the background and takes a few minutes on a large store.
list.staleHeading: Showing what we have on file
list.staleBody: Shopify did not answer, so this list is from our copy, last updated {{minutes}} minutes ago.
list.orphanedBody: They are priced by their tags alone. If their group was deleted, the tier pricing, terms and limits that came with it no longer apply to them.
list.noResultsBody: Try a different search, or widen the filters.
list.repriceNote: New prices apply on this buyer's next visit to your store.

groups.heading: Customer groups
groups.emptyBody: A group bundles pricing, payment terms, order limits and what a tier can see. Start from a template, or name your own.
groups.tagHelp: Members get this tag in Shopify, which is what your pricing rules target.
groups.termsHelp: Leave empty if this tier pays up front. Terms are enforced from phase 3.2.
groups.blockedBody: Deleting the group changes what these buyers pay. Choose where they go first.
groups.destinationNone: No group — price them on their tags alone
groups.duplicateBody: Two groups with the same handle would make it impossible to tell which one a pricing rule means. Pick a different name.

group.bundleBody: A group is a bundle. Each section is owned by the feature that enforces it.
group.noMembers: Nobody is in this group yet.

summary.noPricing: No live pricing rule targets the “{{tag}}” tag, so this tier pays retail.
summary.limits: An order minimum is set on this tier.
summary.shipping: Free shipping above a set subtotal.
summary.noShipping: No shipping rule on this tier.
summary.visibility_one: {{count}} collection is visible to this tier.
summary.visibility_other: {{count}} collections are visible to this tier.
summary.noVisibility: This tier sees your whole catalogue.

group.termsDaysHelp: Net terms for everyone in this group. Leave empty and they pay up front. A buyer's own terms replace these.
group.creditLimitHelp: The most a member may owe at once. Leave empty for no ceiling.

detail.spend_one: {{amount}} across {{count}} order, as recorded by Shopify.
detail.spend_other: {{amount}} across {{count}} orders, as recorded by Shopify.
detail.tagsHelp: Comma separated. These are written to Shopify, and your pricing rules target them.
detail.taxExemptOn: This buyer is not charged tax.
detail.vatRequiredHeading: A VAT id is needed first
detail.vatRequiredBody: This store requires a VAT id before a buyer can be marked tax-exempt. Add it to their account, then try again.
detail.noteHelp: Only your staff sees this. It is never sent to the buyer.
detail.deletedHeading: This customer was deleted in Shopify
detail.deletedBody: We keep the record so your history stays readable, but nothing here can be changed and no price applies to them.
detail.termsNone: Pays up front — no terms set
detail.termsGroupWas: Their group's terms are {{terms}}. This buyer's own terms replace them.
detail.termsDaysHelp: Leave empty to use their group's terms. 15, 30, 60 and 90 are the usual ones.
detail.creditLimitHelp: The most they may owe at once. Leave empty for no ceiling.
detail.termsNewOrdersOnly: Changing these applies to new orders only. Invoices already raised keep the terms the buyer was given.

tagging.heading: Auto-tagging
tagging.emptyBody: A rule tags buyers automatically from what they have spent, how often they order, or where they are. Tags are what your pricing rules target, so a rule here changes what someone pays.
tagging.valueHelp: An amount for spend, a whole number for counts and days, or comma-separated country codes.
tagging.unreadable_one: {{count}} condition could not be read — this rule is held back
tagging.unreadable_other: {{count}} conditions could not be read — this rule is held back
tagging.runNote: Tags are written to Shopify, which changes what these buyers pay.
tagging.previewBody_one: Checked {{count}} buyer against your rules. Nothing has been written.
tagging.previewBody_other: Checked {{count}} buyers against your rules. Nothing has been written.
tagging.ranWithFailures_one: {{count}} buyer could not be updated in Shopify and was skipped.
tagging.ranWithFailures_other: {{count}} buyers could not be updated in Shopify and were skipped.
tagging.lockedHeading: Auto-tagging is not on your plan
tagging.lockedBody: It unlocks on {{plan}}. Your existing tags keep working either way.
tagging.issuesHeading: This rule could not be saved

issue.no_conditions: Add at least one condition — a rule with none matches nobody.
issue.no_tags: Choose at least one tag to add or remove.
issue.tag_added_and_removed: “{{detail}}” is both added and removed by this rule.
issue.unreadable_condition: One of the conditions could not be read.

days_since_last_order.gte_other: No order for {{count}} days or more

list.heading: Registration forms
list.emptyBody: This is how wholesale buyers apply. Start from one of the three below — they differ in how much they ask for, and every extra question costs you applications.
list.limitBody: {{plan}} removes the limit. Your existing form keeps working either way.

template.minimalHelp: Name, email, company. Most applications, least to go on.
template.standardHelp: Adds phone, address, VAT and years trading. The usual balance.
template.strictHelp: Everything, plus a trade licence for distributors. Fewest applications, least review.

field.vatHelp: We check EU numbers automatically. Numbers from other countries are recorded for your review.
field.privacy: I agree to the privacy policy

builder.slugHelp: Used in the form's address. Two forms cannot share one.
builder.noFields: This form asks nothing yet. Add a field below.
builder.fieldOptionsHelp: Comma separated. Only used by a choice field.
builder.issuesHeading: This form cannot go live yet
builder.issuesBody: A draft can be unfinished. These are what stand between it and accepting applications.

issue.too_many_fields: There are {{detail}} fields. That is more than a person will fill in.
issue.no_email_field: Add an email field — without one an application cannot be answered or turned into a customer.
issue.reserved_key: “{{field}}” is a name the form itself uses. Rename the field.
issue.invalid_key: “{{field}}” is not a usable field key.
issue.select_without_options: “{{field}}” is a choice field with nothing to choose from.
issue.condition_unknown_field: “{{field}}” depends on “{{detail}}”, which is not on this form.
issue.condition_self: “{{field}}” depends on itself, so it can never appear.
issue.condition_cycle: These fields depend on each other in a loop, so none of them can ever appear: {{detail}}.
issue.condition_on_hidden_option: “{{field}}” depends on an answer that cannot be given.

emailIssue.unknown_tag: The {{email}} email uses {{detail}}, which is not a merge tag — it would go out to a buyer as written.

emails.subject: Subject
emails.noSenderHeading: No email sender is set up yet
emails.noSenderBody: Nothing was sent. Notification emails start going out when the approval pipeline is connected to a mail provider — until then, applications still arrive and you can answer them yourself.
emails.needsInfoSubject: One more thing about your application

contrast.heading: Readability
contrast.unreadable: One of these is not a colour we can read. Use a hex value like #1c1d2b.

pass.text: Text on the background is {{ratio}}:1. That passes.
pass.accent: Button text on the button is {{ratio}}:1. That passes.

fail.text: Text on the background is only {{ratio}}:1, below the 4.5:1 that people with low vision need. Darken the text or lighten the background.
fail.accent: Button text on the button is only {{ratio}}:1, below 4.5:1. Change one of the two button colours.

publish.linkHelp: Share this anywhere. It works without your theme.
publish.blockHelp: To put the form in your storefront, add the “Wholesale registration” block to a page in the theme editor and paste this link into it.
publish.redirectHelp: Leave empty to show our thank-you page. Only http and https links are accepted.
publish.autoTagsHelp: Comma separated. Applied when you approve the application, not when it arrives.
publish.spamHelp: A hidden decoy field, a minimum fill time, and a limit per address. Uploads are capped at {{megabytes}} MB.
publish.queueComing: The full review queue, with approve and reject, arrives with the approval pipeline.

public.privacyRequired: You need to accept the privacy policy.
public.fileHelp: PDF, JPG or PNG, up to {{megabytes}} MB.

issue.email_format: {{label}} does not look like an email address.
issue.phone_format: {{label}} does not look like a phone number.
issue.number_format: {{label}} needs to be a whole number.
issue.not_an_option: Choose one of the options for {{label}}.
issue.vat_format: {{label}} does not match the format for that country. Check it, or leave it out and we will ask.
issue.privacy_required: You need to accept the privacy policy.
issue.fileType: {{label}} is a {{type}} file. Send a PDF, JPG or PNG.

public.thanksHeading: Thank you — your application is in
public.thanksBody: We will look at it and get back to you by email.
public.alreadyBody: There is already an application from this email address for {{form}}.

status.pending: It is waiting to be reviewed.
status.approved: It has been approved — try signing in.
status.rejected: It was not approved. Get in touch if you think that is wrong.

public.rateLimitedBody: Several applications have come from your connection in the last hour. Wait a little and try again.
public.closedHeading: This form is not accepting applications
public.closedBody: {{form}} is closed at the moment. Try again later, or get in touch with the store.

applications.heading: Applications
applications.emptyBody: When somebody applies through your form, they land here. Share the link and the first one will follow.
applications.screeningUnavailable: ✦ Screening unavailable — review this one yourself. It has never blocked approving anybody.
applications.criteriaNotMet: Does not meet your approval criteria

vatNote.format: The number does not match that country's format.
vatNote.outside_eu: Outside the EU, so VIES cannot confirm it.
vatNote.vies_unreachable: VIES could not be reached, so this is unchecked rather than wrong.

met.has_upload: The file you asked for is attached.

unmet.vat_valid: VAT number is not confirmed. Unverified is not the same as wrong.
unmet.years_in_business_one: Fewer than {{count}} year in business, or they did not say.
unmet.years_in_business_other: Fewer than {{count}} years in business, or they did not say.
unmet.country: Not in {{detail}}, or we do not know where they are.
unmet.existing_customer: Has not bought from you before.

applications.groupHelp: The tier sets their prices and their payment terms.

editEmailHeading.approve: The email they will get when you approve them
editEmailHeading.reject: The email they will get when you turn them down

applications.reasonHelp: Kept internally. Only what you type below is sent.

rejection.outside_area: Outside the area we sell to

applications.undoBody_one: You have {{count}} second to take this back.
applications.undoBody_other: You have {{count}} seconds to take this back.
applications.undoExpiredBody: Undo lasts ten seconds. To reverse an approval after that, reject the buyer — which is a decision with a reason, and undo is not.
applications.noEmailBody: No mail provider is configured, so applicants are not being told when they are approved or turned down. Approving still works, and every message we would have sent is recorded.
applications.needsInfoLabel: What do you need from them?
applications.needsInfoHelp: Emails them and leaves the application here, waiting on their reply.

approval.heading: Approve automatically
approval.intro: Applications that meet every criterion below are approved without anyone looking. Off unless you switch it on.
approval.enabledHelp: Nothing is decided automatically until this is on and at least one criterion is set.
approval.otherwise: When an application does not meet them
approval.otherwiseHelp: Sending them to you is the safe answer. Rejecting automatically turns somebody away without a person reading it.
approval.otherwiseReview: Send it to me to review
approval.noCriteria: No criteria yet, so every application waits for you.
approval.allOf: Approve when all of these are true:
approval.valueHelp: Years for a minimum, country codes separated by commas, a field key for a file, or key=answer.

criterion.vat_valid: VIES has confirmed their VAT number
criterion.years_in_business_one: They have been trading at least {{count}} year
criterion.years_in_business_other: They have been trading at least {{count}} years

issue.no_criteria: Approving automatically is switched on with nothing to check, so nothing will be decided. Add a criterion or switch it off.
issue.years_negative: A number of years cannot be negative.
issue.no_key: Name the field this answer belongs to.

list.heading: Wholesale orders
list.emptyBody: They'll appear here when an approved buyer checks out. Place a test order if you'd like to see how it looks first.
list.emptyTestOrder: How to place a test order
list.syncingBody: The list fills in as it goes.
list.syncingFirstBody: This runs in the background and takes a minute or two.
list.historyNote_one: Showing wholesale orders from the last day. Shopify only lets apps read recent orders.
list.historyNote_other: Showing wholesale orders from the last {{count}} days. Shopify only lets apps read recent orders.
list.resyncBody: Their totals here may be out of date. We'll pick up the new figures shortly; open the order in Shopify if you need the number right now.
list.noResultsBody: Try a different payment status or source, or clear the filters to see everything.
list.searchLabel: Search by order, buyer or email

limits.heading: Order limits
limits.emptyBody: A limit sets the smallest — or largest — order a wholesale buyer can place. For example, a {{example}} minimum for your Silver tier.
limits.emptyExampleMinimum: A {{example}} minimum per order, so small orders go through your retail store instead.
limits.emptyExampleCase: Cases of 12, so buyers can't order 7 of something you ship by the dozen.
limits.emptyExampleMaximum: A maximum order value, so an unusually large order comes to you as a quote first.
limits.groupHelp: A group's limit replaces the store-wide one for its members — they don't stack.
limits.incrementHelp: The cart's total must be a multiple of this. Leave empty if you don't sell by the case.
limits.countriesHelp: Two-letter codes, separated by commas — SA, AE. Leave empty to apply everywhere.
limits.notPublished: These limits haven't reached Shopify yet, so nothing is being held to them. Save a limit to publish them.
limits.posLabel: Orders taken in person ignore these limits
limits.posHelp: On by default: a minimum written for a website isn't usually a rule about a till.
limits.previewBody: Written by the same code that runs at checkout, so this is the wording and the number your buyer gets.
limits.lockedHeading: Order limits are on a paid plan
limits.lockedBody: Limits you've already set keep working — nothing is deleted. Upgrade to {{plan}} to change them.
limits.issuesHeading: This limit can't be saved yet

summary.none: No bounds set — this limit does nothing

issue.no_bounds: Set at least one minimum, maximum or case size. A limit with nothing in it stops nobody.
issue.min_above_max_subtotal: The minimum order value is above the maximum. No cart could satisfy both.
issue.min_above_max_quantity: The minimum number of items is above the maximum. No cart could satisfy both.
issue.negative: Amounts and quantities can't be negative.
issue.increment_too_small: A case size of 1 doesn't restrict anything. Leave it empty instead.
issue.increment_conflicts_with_minimum: The minimum isn't a whole number of cases — the next one up is {{detail}}.
issue.increment_conflicts_with_maximum: The maximum is below one full case, so no cart could ever qualify.

terms.lockedHeading: Net payment terms are on a paid plan
terms.lockedBody: Invoices already on terms keep working and are still shown — nothing is deleted. Upgrade to {{plan}} to change them.
terms.notPublishedHeading: Checkout has not been told about these settings
terms.notPublishedBody: Until they reach Shopify, checkout falls back to its defaults — which can mean your pay-later method is shown to everybody. Save the settings below to publish them.

ledger.heading: Payment terms
ledger.emptyHeading: Nobody is on payment terms yet
ledger.emptyBody: Give a customer group net terms — Net 30, say — and their orders will appear here as invoices to chase.
ledger.allPaidBody: Every invoice on terms has been paid. New ones appear here as buyers on terms check out.

settings.heading: Paying later at checkout
settings.intro: Shopify has no built-in net terms, so set up a manual payment method in your checkout settings and name it here. Mannon hides it from everyone whose terms do not allow it — they see nothing at all, not a disabled button.
settings.methodHelp: The name exactly as it appears in Settings → Payments → Manual payment methods.
settings.methodRequired: Name the payment method. An empty name would match every method and hide the whole payment step.
settings.showDaysLabel: Rename it at checkout to say the buyer's terms
settings.showDaysHelp: An eligible buyer sees “Pay later (Net 30)” rather than having to guess what applies to them.
settings.overdueBlocksLabel: An overdue invoice stops further credit
settings.overdueBlocksHelp: A buyer with anything past its due date has to pay now, until they settle it.

quotes.lockedHeading: Quotes are on a paid plan
quotes.lockedBody: Quotes you have already sent still stand and their links still work — nothing is deleted. Upgrade to {{plan}} to send more.

list.heading: Quotes
list.emptyBody: Build a quote for a buyer who asked for a price, or wait for one to arrive from your storefront. Prices are fixed the moment you draft it, so a buyer who accepts next week pays this week's price.
list.noResultsBody: Try a different status, or clear the filters to see everything.
list.searchLabel: Search by quote number, buyer or email

detail.noLinesBody: Search your catalogue above and add what the buyer asked for. Prices come from your wholesale rules.
detail.lockedAt: Prices fixed on {{at}}. They do not change unless you re-price this quote.
detail.driftHeading: Your rules have changed since this was priced
detail.driftBody: The prices below are the ones this buyer was quoted and the ones they will be charged. Where the store would now charge something different, the line says so. Re-price the quote if you would rather offer today's price.
detail.suggestionBody: Claude drafts a reply and checks it against your margin floor.
detail.suggestionUnavailable: Claude will draft a reply here and check it against your margin floor. That arrives with the rest of the AI features.
detail.messageHelp: Goes in the email and appears above the prices on their page.
detail.internalNoteHelp: Staff only. The buyer never sees this.
detail.sentLocked: This quote is with the buyer, so its prices cannot be changed. Withdraw it if you need to offer something different.
detail.linkBody: The same link that went in their email. Anyone with it can accept the quote, so share it only with them.
detail.acceptedBody: This quote became a draft order in Shopify, at the prices quoted. Invoice or complete it there.

public.heading: Quote {{number}}
public.acceptedThanks: Thank you — we have passed this to the seller, who will be in touch to complete your order.
public.declinedThanks: Thank you for letting us know.
public.closedAccepted: You have already accepted this quote. The seller will be in touch to complete your order.
public.closedDeclined: This quote was declined. Get in touch with the seller if that was a mistake.
public.closedExpired: This quote has run out. Get in touch with the seller if you would still like it.
public.closedNotSent: This quote is not ready yet. The seller will send it to you when it is.

describe.heading: ✦ Describe a rule
describe.composerHeading: Say what you want in one sentence
describe.sentenceHelp: Claude drafts it. Nothing changes until you approve the draft.
describe.example1: Buy 10 get 5%, buy 50 get 12%, only for customers tagged wholesale, exclude sale items.
describe.example2: Gold group pays 30% off everything, from the first of next month.
describe.example3: Free-shipping tier: 10% off any order over 2,000.
describe.offBody: This store has no Anthropic API key, so Claude cannot draft rules here. Everything else works — build the rule yourself and it will price exactly the same.
describe.atLimitHeading: Your plan's rule limit is used up
describe.atLimitBody: You can still draft a rule, but approving it needs a free slot. Archive a rule you no longer use, or move to a bigger plan.
describe.draftIntro: ✦ Drafted by Claude · review it before it goes live. You approve it, not the AI.
describe.combinable: May combine with your other Mannon rules.
describe.notCombinable: Does not combine with your other Mannon rules.
describe.clarifyBody: Claude named something it could not match to this store. Pick what you meant — approving is off until you do.
describe.noSuchThing: Nothing in this store is called “{{term}}”. Open the builder to pick it yourself.
describe.approveAnywayLabel: I know this sells below cost, and I want it anyway
describe.approveAnywayHelp: Some merchants price a line at a loss on purpose. Mannon will not stop you — it just will not do it quietly.
describe.confirmMissingHeading: Tick the box to approve this one
describe.confirmMissingBody: This rule sells at least one product below what it costs you. Approving it needs the confirmation above.

no_key.heading: Drafting is switched off
no_key.body: This store has no Anthropic API key. Build the rule yourself — it will price exactly the same.

timeout.heading: Claude did not answer in time
timeout.body: Try again, or build the rule yourself. Nothing was saved.

rate_limited.heading: Too many requests just now
rate_limited.body: Wait a moment and try again, or build the rule yourself.

refused.heading: Claude did not draft that one
refused.body: Try describing the rule differently, or build it yourself.

invalid_output.heading: That draft could not be read
invalid_output.body: Claude's answer did not make a valid rule, twice. Try a simpler sentence, or build it yourself.

error.heading: Drafting failed
error.body: Something went wrong on the way to Claude. Try again, or build the rule yourself.

empty.heading: Say what the rule should do
empty.body: One sentence is enough — quantities, discount, and who it is for.

margin.clearBody_one: Checked {{count}} product against your recorded costs.
margin.clearBody_other: Checked {{count}} products against your recorded costs.
margin.costUnknown_one: {{count}} of them has no cost recorded in Shopify, so it could not be checked.
margin.costUnknown_other: {{count}} of them have no cost recorded in Shopify, so they could not be checked.
margin.sampled: This rule covers more products than were checked — the check is a sample, not the whole catalogue.
margin.unavailableBody: Shopify did not answer, so Mannon cannot say whether this rule sells anything below cost. You can still approve it.
